bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDY has reviewed issuer-native liability surfaces on Ethereum, Plume, Sui, Aptos, Stellar, and Noble. Arbitrum, Mantle, Sei, BNB Chain, Tempo and Solana have LayerZero burn/mint routes. BNB Chain and Tempo also have issuer-listed InstantManagers with current local mint authority; independent-liability versus bridge accounting for those additional workflows is not established by the route inventory. Solana's SPL mint authority is 1-of-2 between the OFT authority and a Squads V3 authority PDA governed by a separately observed 4-of-7 parent; it is not a plain independently signing key. Osmosis, Mantra, and Injective are Noble-sourced IBC vouchers with reviewed escrow matches. DefiLlama's trace Penumbra and Glue labels remain an accepted bounded pool.
